title: Async tensor copy on the transfer queue is not ordered after the producer graph the consumer backend waited for (event wait applied to the compute context only)
expected_finding: the transfer-queue submission that copies tensor_a into tensor_b waits on nothing, so its TRANSFER read of tensor_a is unordered against backend A's scale_f32 dispatch writing tensor_a on the compute (graphics) queue; only backend B's compute submission waits on the event semaphore
